fusions.name: Chink in the Plate
fusions.desc: Throws a narrow blade that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Cut the Straps
fusions.desc: A quick cut at the buckles that deals 7 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Muffled Mail
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 18% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Glancing Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
